```{ojs}
//| echo: false
jmp_cost_data = FileAttachment("/data/jmp_cost_sensitivity.json").json().catch(() => null)
jmp_cost_failed = jmp_cost_data === null ? html`<p class="figcaption"><strong>${t("failed")}</strong></p><img src="/assets/img/jmp_cost_sensitivity.png" alt="${LANG === "zh" ? "四种组合方法、三种特征库写法下，年化平均超额收益随单边成本（0 至 100 个基点）的变化" : "Annual mean excess return against one-way cost from 0 to 100 basis points for four portfolio procedures and three versions of the library"}" style="width:100%">` : html``
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof jmp_cost_bp = Inputs.range([0, 100], { value: 25, step: 1, label: t("cost_bp") })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Exact values exist only at 0, 10, 25, 50 and 100 bp; between them the value is a straight-line interpolation.
jmp_cost_interp = (bp, xs, ys) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < xs.length - 1; i++) {
    if (bp >= xs[i] && bp <= xs[i + 1]) {
      const w = (bp - xs[i]) / (xs[i + 1] - xs[i])
      return ys[i] + w * (ys[i + 1] - ys[i])
    }
  }
  return NaN
}
jmp_cost_exact = jmp_cost_data ? jmp_cost_data.bp.includes(jmp_cost_bp) : true
jmp_cost_colors = [palette.naipca_iab, palette.qz_ipca, palette.rp_pca]
jmp_cost_dash = [null, "6 3", "2 3"]
jmp_cost_ylabel = LANG === "zh" ? "年化平均超额收益（%）" : "Annual mean excess return (%)"
jmp_cost_repName = (r) => LANG === "zh" ? ({ "Original": "原始特征库", "Balanced": "主题均衡", "Value copies": "价值主题复制五份" }[r] ?? r) : ({ "Balanced": "Theme-balanced", "Value copies": "Value copied five times" }[r] ?? r)
jmp_cost_methodName = (m) => LANG === "zh" ? ({ "Blocked ridge": "分块岭回归", "SR-weighted": "夏普加权岭回归", "LOO ridge": "留一法岭回归", "UPSA": "UPSA" }[m] ?? m) : ({ "SR-weighted": "Sharpe-weighted ridge" }[m] ?? m)
jmp_cost_points = jmp_cost_data ? jmp_cost_data.series.flatMap((s) => jmp_cost_data.bp.map((bp, i) => ({ method: s.method, rep: s.rep, bp, v: s.mean[i] }))) : []
jmp_cost_now = jmp_cost_data ? jmp_cost_data.series.map((s) => ({ method: s.method, rep: s.rep, bp: jmp_cost_bp, v: jmp_cost_interp(jmp_cost_bp, jmp_cost_data.bp, s.mean) })) : []
jmp_cost_ydomain = jmp_cost_points.length ? [Math.min(...jmp_cost_points.map((d) => d.v)), Math.max(...jmp_cost_points.map((d) => d.v))] : [0, 1]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
jmp_cost_chart = {
  if (!jmp_cost_data) return html``
  const panels = jmp_cost_data.methods.map((m) => {
    const pts = jmp_cost_points.filter((d) => d.method === m)
    const now = jmp_cost_now.filter((d) => d.method === m)
    const chart = Plot.plot({
      width: 330, height: 230, marginLeft: 48, marginRight: 12, marginTop: 24, marginBottom: 40,
      style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 11 },
      ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? `${jmp_cost_methodName(m)}：${jmp_cost_ylabel}随单边成本的变化` : `${jmp_cost_methodName(m)}: ${jmp_cost_ylabel} against one-way cost`,
      ariaDescription: LANG === "zh"
        ? `三条线分别为原始特征库、主题均衡和价值主题复制五份，精确点位于 0、10、25、50 和 100 个基点，标记位于 ${jmp_cost_bp} 个基点。`
        : `Three lines, original, theme-balanced and value copied five times, exact at 0, 10, 25, 50 and 100 basis points, with a marker at ${jmp_cost_bp} bp.`,
      x: { label: LANG === "zh" ? "单边成本（每交易一美元的基点数）" : "One-way cost (bp per traded dollar)", domain: [0, 100] },
      y: { label: jmp_cost_ylabel, domain: jmp_cost_ydomain, grid: true, nice: true },
      color: { domain: jmp_cost_data.reps, range: jmp_cost_colors },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: palette.muted }),
        Plot.ruleX([jmp_cost_bp], { stroke: palette.muted, strokeDasharray: "3 3" }),
        ...jmp_cost_data.reps.map((r, i) => Plot.line(pts.filter((d) => d.rep === r), { x: "bp", y: "v", stroke: "rep", strokeWidth: 1.8, strokeDasharray: jmp_cost_dash[i] })),
        Plot.dot(pts, { x: "bp", y: "v", fill: "rep", r: 2.2 }),
        Plot.dot(now, { x: "bp", y: "v", stroke: "rep", fill: "white", r: 4.5, strokeWidth: 2 })
      ]
    })
    return html`<div><div style="font-weight:600;font-size:13px;margin:0 0 2px 4px;">${jmp_cost_methodName(m)}</div>${chart}</div>`
  })
  const styleName = LANG === "zh" ? ["（实线）", "（虚线）", "（点线）"] : [" (solid)", " (dashed)", " (dotted)"]
  const legend = Plot.legend({ color: { domain: jmp_cost_data.reps, range: jmp_cost_colors, tickFormat: (r) => jmp_cost_repName(r) + styleName[jmp_cost_data.reps.indexOf(r)] }, style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 } })
  return html`<div>${legend}<div class="jmp-cost-grid" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px;">${panels}</div></div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
jmp_cost_table = {
  if (!jmp_cost_data) return html``
  const f = (x) => (x < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2)
  const fd = (x) => (Math.abs(x) < 0.005 ? "" : x < 0 ? "−" : "+") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2)
  const inTable = jmp_cost_bp === 0 || jmp_cost_bp === 25
  const unit = LANG === "zh" ? "（年化平均超额收益，%；括号内为与原始特征库之差，百分点）" : " (annual mean excess return, %; in brackets, difference from the original library, pp)"
  const head = jmp_cost_exact
    ? (LANG === "zh" ? `${jmp_cost_bp} 个基点：${inTable ? "表 IV（第 27 页）报告的数值" : "图 3（第 33 页）所绘数值"}${unit}` : `${jmp_cost_bp} bp: ${inTable ? "reported in Table IV, p. 27" : "plotted in the paper's Figure 3, p. 33"}${unit}`)
    : (LANG === "zh" ? `${jmp_cost_bp} 个基点：由相邻两个精确值线性插值得到，并非论文报告的数值${unit}` : `${jmp_cost_bp} bp: interpolated between neighbouring exact points, not a value reported in the paper${unit}`)
  const v = (m, r) => jmp_cost_now.find((d) => d.method === m && d.rep === r).v
  const val = (m, r) => r === "Original" ? f(v(m, r)) : (LANG === "zh" ? `${f(v(m, r))}（${fd(v(m, r) - v(m, "Original"))}）` : `${f(v(m, r))} (${fd(v(m, r) - v(m, "Original"))})`)
  return html`<div>
    <div class="note"><strong>${head}</strong></div>
    <div class="table-scroll"><table class="tbl-num">
      <thead><tr><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "方法" : "Method"}</th>${jmp_cost_data.reps.map((r) => html`<th>${jmp_cost_repName(r)}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>${jmp_cost_data.methods.map((m) => html`<tr><td>${jmp_cost_methodName(m)}</td>${jmp_cost_data.reps.map((r) => html`<td>${val(m, r)}</td>`)}</tr>`)}</tbody>
    </table></div>
  </div>`
}
```
